row.evidence: Peakon's developer docs say it "supports automatic and continuous user provisioning though its SCIM 2.0 API, available to all Peakon customers"; Workday publishes no Peakon pricing, so it is sold only through sales.
row.notes: Quote-only: Workday Peakon Employee Voice has no public plans or prices; under the quote-only rule SCIM is recorded as gated (low confidence), although the developer docs state SCIM is available to all Peakon customers, so there is no tier upcharge beyond buying the product. SCIM 2.0 at https://{subdomain}.peakon.com/api/scim/v2 with a bearer token from Integrations > Employee Provisioning; supports create, read/filter, PUT update, activate/deactivate, delete and bulk; no Group resource. Custom employee attributes go in the urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:peakon:2.0:User extension. Okta OIN app lists SAML and SCIM (Create, Update, Deactivate); Entra gallery has SSO and provisioning tutorials. SAML SSO is self-serve in Administration > Integrations, plan not stated. Separate Peakon REST API (Custom Apps) has employee CRUD and an audits endpoint. HRIS employee sync integrations (Workday, BambooHR, Personio) also exist.

auth.token_source: Administration > Integrations > Employee Provisioning > Enable (SCIM URL and OAuth Bearer Token)

deprovision.notes: Activate/deactivate and delete are both supported; what deactivation does to survey participation or data is not documented.

pagination.notes: Listed among the SCIM spec sections relevant to the Peakon SCIM API; sample list response shows itemsPerPage 50.

custom.how: Company employee attributes (e.g. Gender, Team, Manager, Date of Birth) sent in the urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:peakon:2.0:User extension, keyed by attribute name

limitations.text: SCIM Group resource is not supported; Entra must sync Users only.
On-premises Active Directory must sync to Entra ID (Azure AD) first.
Entra tenant URL must omit /scim/v2, which Entra appends.
Create and update are separate calls: create with basic fields, then PUT all attributes so referenced employees (e.g. Manager) exist.

auth.notes: Custom App access token (permission-scoped, chosen at creation) is exchanged at POST /auth/application for a JWT session token.

endpoints.purpose: Authenticate application (exchange app token for JWT)

okta.notes: OIN page ticks SAML and SCIM, with provisioning Create, Update and Deactivate (no Group Push); ticks read from the page markup.

onelogin.notes: Peakon names OneLogin among SCIM 2.0 identity systems it works with; no OneLogin catalogue page checked.

fallbacks.other_sync: HRIS employee sync integrations (e.g. BambooHR, Personio, Workday) under Employee Sync Integrations
